specifications.author: Original IAT research-policy composition
specifications.constraints: 0.01 lot, one position, five openings per UTC day, 1% daily admission/latch; qualified costs and opening marks required.
specifications.entry: Unchanged original candidate predicates, eligible closed M1/M5 evidence; next executable quote strictly AFTER decision, within two seconds.
specifications.exit: Broker-side SL/TP quote crossings; next close-permitted quote after original anchor invalidation/retirement or 15-minute holding horizon.
specifications.identity: Existing canonical setup anchor plus new specification version/hash; same setup cannot rearm after close.
specifications.invalidation: Original anchored INVALIDATED event; continuation loses M5 trend; blocked evidence makes outcome inconclusive, not a fabricated exit.
specifications.missing_data: Abstain; no imputation, no unconfirmed pivot, no forming M5, no caller/model approval.
specifications.regime: Continuation: M1/M5 direction aligned. Sweep: established M5 structure, original post-sweep CLOSE CHoCH; opposite M5 allowed as in original research.
specifications.session: Verified quote and new-position permissions; close-only permits exits only; UNKNOWN blocks.
specifications.stop: Last available confirmed M1 LOW for BUY / HIGH for SELL; sweep also includes swept level; one tick beyond the adverse extreme, adverse tick-grid rounding. Reject invalid geometry.
specifications.target: 2R from actual simulated bid/ask entry with declared adverse slippage; tick-rounded away from entry.
specifications.volatility: Existing relative volatility in [0.67,1.5], available ATR/momentum observations; no new indicator or confluence tuning.
